verdict.rationale: Bento is an email marketing SaaS with built-in AI features, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents Bento's own MCP server, which exposes Bento to external AI assistants (the server role), and that does not count toward this client story. Nothing in the pack shows Bento's product or its AI builder connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.
